offering_description.value: Provides outsourced sales, merchandising and marketing services to consumer goods brands and retailers. Its account teams represent brands to retailers, and its field teams stock shelves, set up displays and run in-store product demonstrations.

primary_services.value: retail sales representation; retail merchandising and shelf replenishment; in-store product demonstrations and sampling; shopper marketing; retail sales analytics

customer_segment.value: B2B: consumer packaged goods manufacturers, grocery chains, mass merchants and warehouse clubs

end_markets.value: consumer packaged goods; grocery retail; mass merchandise retail; warehouse club retail; drugstore retail

revenue_model.value: project or contract: ongoing sales and merchandising programs and contracted product demonstration campaigns; commissions or management fees: commissions on manufacturer sales to retailers under sales representation agreements
revenue_model.category: project or contract; commissions or management fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: uses brand product catalogs and retailer store plans to run sales, merchandising and sampling programs for brands and retailers

geography_served.value: North America: United States and Canada

specialization.value: related lines: brand sales representation, retail merchandising, product demonstrations and shopper marketing

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: account teams contract directly with consumer goods manufacturers and retail chains

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: in-store food sampling is subject to state and local food handling and sanitation rules

notes: The extent of current wholly owned operations outside the United States and Canada is uncertain.
